0.why: LuciControINFcoarse.cpp LuciControlINFcoarse::process: the knob, which runs 0 to 10, is written out with a parameter read added to it, commit 215f17aa, the head of the maker’s repository and the only commit carrying version 2.0.0, whose res/ matches the installed panels

comment: The maker gave no name to any knob, jack or button on this module, so hovering one shows no tooltip at all. The process function reads params[INFLUENCE_FINE_INPUT] where it plainly meant inputs[INFLUENCE_FINE_INPUT]. That index is 1 and the module declares only one parameter, so the added term is a read past the end of the parameter list rather than any control; the jack on the panel does nothing. Input 0 is declared with no jack and cannot be reached either.
